enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Adjust pillow under head. Close eyes. Breathe in. Breathe out. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Push blanket down. Stretch legs. Curl up. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Put on clothes. Brush teeth. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast using the kettle and toaster
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out bread, butter, jam. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Press lever. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Take out plate and knife. Toast pops up. Remove toast. Place on plate. Spread butter. Spread jam. Eat toast. Drink tea. Wash plate and knife. Put away. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Vacuuming and tidying the living room
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on living room light. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum cleaner. Turn on vacuum cleaner. Vacuum floor. Move couch. Vacuum under couch. Move coffee table. Vacuum under coffee table. Turn off vacuum cleaner. Unplug vacuum cleaner. Put away vacuum cleaner. Pick up items on floor. Place items on shelf. Dust coffee table. Arrange pillows on couch. Fold blanket. Turn off living room light.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing community program plans and emails on the computer at the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Press power button. Wait for computer to boot. Log in with password. Open email application. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open document with program plans. Review plans. Make notes on paper. Highlight important sections. Open calendar. Schedule meetings. Close document. Close email application. Shut down computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up.

Put on shoes. Pick up keys. Pick up wallet. Open door. Step out. Close door. Lock door. Walk down stairs. Walk along sidewalk. Cross street. Look both ways. Continue walking. Walk past park. Walk past school. Arrive at shops.

Enter grocery store. Pick up shopping basket. Walk to produce section. Pick up apples. Pick up bananas. Place in basket. Walk to dairy section. Pick up milk. Pick up cheese. Place in basket. Walk to meat section. Pick up chicken. Place in basket. Walk to bakery. Pick up bread. Place in basket. Walk to checkout. Place items on counter. Pay cashier. Receive change. Bag items. Pick up bags. Walk out of store. Walk home. Open door. Enter home. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating lunch using the induction cooker and range hood
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Turn on range hood. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, chicken. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add chicken. Stir chicken. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add sauce. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Turn off range hood. Take out plate. Serve food on plate. Sit at table. Eat lunch. Drink water. Wash plate. Put away.

Open dishwasher door. Pull out bottom rack. Scrape food off plates into bin. Rinse plates. Load plates into dishwasher. Load glasses into dishwasher. Load cutlery into basket. Push bottom rack in. Pull out top rack. Load cups. Push top rack in. Add detergent to dispenser. Close dishwasher door. Press start button. Wipe kitchen counter. Turn off kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending the local community festival on the public holiday
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to festival location. Arrive at festival. Look at stalls. Talk to vendor. Buy food. Eat food. Watch performance. Clap hands. Walk to another stall. Look at crafts. Pick up item. Put down item. Talk to friend. Shake hands. Walk to stage. Listen to music. Dance. Walk around. Sit on bench. Rest. Stand up. Walk home.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote control. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Put feet on coffee table. Adjust pillow. Change channel. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Put down remote. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Calling family and journaling on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open phone app. Dial family number. Press call button. Talk to family. Laugh. Say goodbye. Press end call. Open journal app. Type journal entry. Save entry. Close journal app. Lock phone. Put down phone. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner using the oven and induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Turn on range hood. Preheat oven. Open refrigerator. Take out fish, vegetables. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Season fish. Place fish on baking tray. Place tray in oven. Set timer. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add sauce. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Take out plates. Check fish. Remove fish from oven. Turn off oven. Turn off range hood. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Wash dishes. Put away.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up the kitchen after dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Clear table. Scrape food off plates into bin. Rinse plates. Open dishwasher. Load plates. Load glasses. Load cutlery. Close dishwasher. Wipe table. Wipe counters. Sweep floor. Turn off kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Playing video games and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up game controller. Turn on game console. Turn on TV. Select game. Play game. Press buttons. Move controller. Pause game. Put down controller. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up controller. Resume game. Play game. Turn off game console. Turn off TV. Put down controller. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down with the phone before sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media app. Scroll through feed. Like post. Open video app. Watch video. Close video app. Open reading app. Read article. Close reading app. Lock phone. Put down phone. Turn off bedside lamp. Lie down.

Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Adjust pillow under head. Close eyes. Breathe in. Breathe out. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Push blanket down. Stretch legs. Curl up. Sleep.
